senses.gloss: c. (contract. of זעזטא, reduplic. of זע, v. זוּעַ. cmp. forms like גְּזוּזְטְרָא a. גִּיסְטְרָא) slender, young; small; Targ. I Chr. XVIII, 17.
units: Ib. XI, 22 יומא ז׳ short day.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 36b:1">B. Bath. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>פירא ז׳</he> small crop (as grass, aftermath &c.), opp. <he>פ׳ רבא</he> grains &c.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 66b:3">Keth. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>שומא ז׳</he> the taxation on a small scale; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Ketubot 106a:3">Ib. 106ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="A01840"><he>אֱלִיָּהוּ</he></cite>. [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 4:2:5">Y. Yeb. IV, 5ᵈ</cite> top, read: <cite ref="G00328"><he>זִיטָא</he></cite>.—Lam. R. introd. (R. Josh. 2), v. preced.]—Pl. <cite ref="G00159"><he>זוּטֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 8a:9">Ab. Zar. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>יומי ז׳</he> the short days of the Winter.
Ib. 10ᵇ [read:] ז׳ … מחיי מיתי נינהו (v. En Yak. a. l.) even the least among you can revive the dead.—זוּטָא, זוּטִי (as surname) junior.
